notes.title: The actual update
notes.content: I think I may have accidentally pushed the previous build instead of a new one.

notes.title: Reverting because I found some bugs with the new patch
notes.content: Had some bugs in patch 0.9 so I am switching back to 0.8 until I can get those sorted.  I'm going out of town on the 6th, so I'll try to make sure I get 0.9 fixed by then

notes.title: 0.7 hotfix 1
notes.content: Okay, I figured out why Portal Mage wasn't going through the jump on build even though he was in editor.  I had a custom shader to make him disappear through the portal, but you have to specifically include custom shaders in the build, even though unity will auto detect them in editor.  He should be jumping properly now.  As a bonus I fixed the bug were the arcane herb buff was just appearing in the middle of the screen instead of on the caster.

notes.title: Cast or Pass 0.5 Hotfix 2
notes.content: Okay, I think it's fixed, fingers crossed.

notes.title: Cast or Pass 0.5 hotfix
notes.content: I don't know how this got past me, but apparently the game was uncontrollable.  Something must have saved improperly since it was working before.  Hopefully it should be working now.  There is gonna be some incomplete progress in the library screen on this hotfix because I am rushing to get it out so the game doesn't stay at an unplayable state.  An official update will still come at the end of the month

notes.title: Cast or Pass 0.3 Patch
notes.content:
New character added: Cold Blooded Caster.

Cold Blooded Caster pays health costs for blood magic with Blood Bolt, Enrage, and the new card: Vampiric Drain.
Cold Blooded Caster restores health using Absorb and Vampiric Drain.
Cold Blooded Caster slows down the pace of the fight with Frostbite and Snowball.

Full Deck List:
1x Absorb
1x Blood Bolt
1x Enrage
1x Frostbite
1x Health Potion
1x Retain
2x Shield
1x Snowball
2x Vampiric Drain
---
I heard tell of a bug where player 1 controller was controlling both players.  I did not have that on my end, so there are no fixes to that. May have been a bad build I put out, or it could have been an issue with steam deck, so let me know if that is an issue on this build and I'll try to get out a hot fix.
---
Sorry about the late update.  I will be back on regular schedule and have a bit more to come out than just a character next update.

notes.title: Cast Or Pass 0.2 Patch
notes.content:
New character added: Slime Wizard.

Slime Wizard fills the opponents deck with status cards using the new cards Goop Spray and Blood Bolt.
Slime Wizard makes it difficult to remove these cards by using Frostbite.
Slime Wizard can use the new Absorb card to heal from incoming attacks to get more time to status the opponent.

Full Deck List:
1x Absorb
1x Blood Bolt
2x Frostbite
3x Goop Spray
1x Retain
2x Shield
---
A and B now work for menu navigation (A being advance and B being back).
X and Circle should work for PlayStation controllers, but I don't have any of those to test so if anyone who has one can test that for me, I would appreciate it
---
Did some bug fixing with menu navigation.  Down and Up are correctly mapped on the opening screen now and you should only scroll one character at a time now even when you are using controller.

notes.title: Cast Or Pass 0.1 Hotfix 1
notes.content:
Cast Or Pass 0.1 Hotfix 1
I added pausing into the game so you can exit quickly, and fixed some bugs with the prefabs that made it so that sometimes the target dummy would be controlled by the player in the tutorial.  Sorry about that everyone! 

As a bit of a sneak peak, I have been working on getting art for Slime Wizard, and will hope to have them available for the first full update which I plan to release on August 1st.
